body: Main decision: accept the separation. The helper authorizes ONLY preservation of the exact producer-owned record using current local-pending ownership/layout; it is NOT the reviewed-manifest/Git authorization gate. Native application already MUST await the REAL persistLearningPreparedPlan callback before any canonical mutation; that Core.current() check validates current reviewed state even on idempotent persisted-plan replay. Keep that mandatory ordering and the real callback in the positive consumer; never substitute a no-op in production coordinator. No new read-only core validator, no broader helper-currentness requirement, and no core scope expansion. Existing explicit helper contract is sufficient; do not make late code/doc edits merely for this decision. Reviewer: finalize c2 against this boundary. Writer: submit existing final45-test/lint/all3-tsc proof with the decision and reviewer status once resolved; no repeated checks or hidden unmet behavior. Rationale: file preservation does not execute the imported/old manifest. The existing mandatory core persistence boundary already performs current() before the native canonical write and retains one authority convention. Adding a second freshness validator would duplicate that protocol and widen this bounded ticket.
